assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production background art for an original goofy cartoon football management game, widescreen landscape 16:10. A fully illustrated small football club courtyard as one cohesive cutaway diorama, viewed at a slightly elevated three-quarter angle. Thick irregular dark navy ink outlines, tactile flat hand-painted cel colors, dry brush and paper grain, exaggerated charming crooked architecture, adult sports-comedy personality, muted teal, forest green, warm ochre, cream, dusty red. No realism, no 3D rendering, no cute chibi characters. Clear distinct interactive objects, generously spaced: LEFT MIDGROUND a small red-roof wooden locker-room clubhouse with wide open double doors and hanging green football shirt, visible benches; CENTER MIDGROUND a covered dugout with large freestanding chalk tactics board showing only simple white field lines and circles; RIGHT MIDGROUND a warmly lit manager's office window with desk, calculator and ledger; BACK LEFT a fenced training pitch with orange cones and practice goal; BACK RIGHT a compact football stadium grandstand and entrance arch; FRONT LEFT a battered mustard scouting minivan with roof suitcase and map; FRONT CENTER a wooden newspaper kiosk with folded blank sports newspapers and a vintage television showing a blank dark green screen; FRONT RIGHT a small wooden display cabinet with football trophies. Trees, floodlights, small pennants, scattered footballs and paths connect the buildings. Central courtyard has clear paths. Fill the frame with the club, no large blank sky. NO WORDS, no letters, no UI, no labels, no floating panels or infographic, no fake readable statistics. No people. This is environment art onto which real HTML hotspots will be overlaid. Crisp rich environment illustration with readable object silhouettes at small scale. Original artwork, no existing game logos or characters.

No humans, no characters, no jerseys, no letters, no words, no UI panels, no readable statistics. Not realistic, not 3D, not anime, not chibi. Original hand-painted cartoon environment, warm and a bit wonky, detailed but usable as actual interactive game backdrop.
